children: Abu Dhabi Commercial Bank is on track to increase its market share after solid third-quarter results, according to JPMorgan. The analysts upgraded their price target for the stock to 21.20 dirhams from 17.54 dirhams, implying share-price growth of 21%. JPMorgan says the upgrade is due to continued asset-quality strength and updated banking tax assumptions in the United Arab Emirates. The analysts now expect the U.A.E. to offer a 9% tax rate, lower than the previously conservative 15% assumption, thus boosting profit views. ADCB shares are 0.3% lower at 17.50 dirhams. (joseph.wilkins@wsj.com)
